message.content: I start by sorting the laundry bags and making sure everything is clean. Then I fold the towels and put them away in the right places. There's also some cleaning to do, like wiping down the carts and making sure the area is tidy. I try to stay focused on the tasks to keep my mind occupied. Most days, things go smoothly, but sometimes I hear that voice again, and it's hard to concentrate. I just try to ignore it and keep working.
